title: Split Dashboard Follow Market strategies into one category per currency
author: agent:/root

originalRequests.text: Создай в Dashboard отдельные категории для FollowMarket стратегий - по одной для каждой валюты

scope.goal: Make the Dashboard expose the existing BTC, ETH, and SOL Follow Market strategies as three separate currency-specific categories.
inScope: Classify every existing BTC Follow Market M N strategy as Dashboard category 'BTC Follow Market'.
Classify every existing ETH Follow Market M N strategy as Dashboard category 'ETH Follow Market'.
Classify every existing SOL Follow Market M N strategy as Dashboard category 'SOL Follow Market'.
Apply the three categories through the existing Dashboard category-option and category-filter path for the all-time, 24-hour, 6-hour, and 1-hour strategy views.
Add focused regression coverage and a concise README description of the Dashboard category split.
outOfScope: Changing Follow Market strategy identities, names, catalog membership, M/N grids, market interval, threshold logic, order side, FAK semantics, 0.99 price cap, minimum stake, retry behavior, PaperOnly/Live state, or trading execution.
Changing the persisted strategy Category value or any database row, schema, migration, seed, or production state.
Changing categories for any non-Follow-Market strategy.
Changing Dashboard layout, controls, time windows, currency filters, metrics, ordering, or any other Dashboard behavior.
Deployment, service restart, or runtime/production mutation.
scope.periodOrFilter: The current exact catalog of 270 BTC/ETH/SOL Follow Market strategies: 90 per asset, with M=30..270 seconds in steps of 30 and N=50..95 cents in steps of 5; Dashboard all-time, 24-hour, 6-hour, and 1-hour strategy views.
scope.firstVerification: Inspect the current Follow Market strategy-name format and the exact Dashboard category derivation and filtering call path before editing.

requirements.text: Expose exactly one separate Dashboard Follow Market category for each existing currency: BTC, ETH, and SOL.
requirements.sourceQuote: отдельные категории для FollowMarket стратегий - по одной для каждой валюты
acceptanceCriteria: The 90 existing BTC Follow Market strategy names resolve to exactly one category, 'BTC Follow Market'.
The 90 existing ETH Follow Market strategy names resolve to exactly one category, 'ETH Follow Market'.
The 90 existing SOL Follow Market strategy names resolve to exactly one category, 'SOL Follow Market'.
Across the exact 270-strategy Follow Market catalog, category grouping has exactly three keys with exactly 90 strategies per key.
The existing Dashboard category option builders and category predicates consume these resolved names for the all-time, 24-hour, 6-hour, and 1-hour views without a separate data or persistence change.

verification.command: Run the exact FollowMarketStrategiesHaveOneDisplayCategoryPerAsset test, then run the complete StrategyDisplayCategoryTests class both from the changed tree and from a detached clean approved-parent worktree, with all disposable outputs under the active marked D:/CodexTemp run.
verification.expected: The exact Follow Market test passes with three categories and 90 variants per asset. The complete changed-tree class adds that passing test and has no new failure compared with the clean approved parent: both runs retain only the same six pre-existing unrelated stale-count failures.
verification.evidence: The exact FollowMarketStrategiesHaveOneDisplayCategoryPerAsset Release test passed 1/1 and asserted all 270 catalog variants group into exactly BTC Follow Market=90, ETH Follow Market=90, and SOL Follow Market=90. The changed complete class produced 97 passed and the same six failed tests out of 103; detached clean approved parent 4762d746 produced 96 passed and the same six failed tests out of 102. TRX comparison proved the six failed fully qualified names identical, and their expected/actual stale catalog counts were unchanged.

verification.command: Inspect MainViewModel.BuildStrategyCategoryOptions and MainViewModel.IsStrategyCategoryVisible after the classifier change.
verification.expected: Both Dashboard option construction and row filtering still derive categories through StrategyDisplayCategories.GetCategory for the all-time, 24-hour, 6-hour, and 1-hour views.
verification.evidence: Direct source inspection confirmed MainViewModel.RefreshStrategyCategoryOptions builds all-time, 24-hour, 6-hour, and 1-hour option lists through BuildStrategyCategoryOptions, which selects StrategyDisplayCategories.GetCategory; IsStrategyCategoryVisible uses the same classifier for every corresponding row filter. Independent reviewer also confirmed the XAML bindings and both call paths.

requirements.text: Keep the change presentation-only and preserve all trading and non-Follow-Market category behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: No Follow Market trading/catalog/persistence implementation file changes except the shared display-category classifier used by Dashboard.
The Release solution build passes with zero errors.
git diff --check, requirement-contract WorkingTree and Staged validation, and independent semantic review pass.

assumptions.text: The three visible Dashboard category labels will be exactly 'BTC Follow Market', 'ETH Follow Market', and 'SOL Follow Market'.
assumptions.impact: These exact strings will appear in the existing Dashboard category selectors and will be used by the existing category filters; no strategy names or stored Category values will change.

deviations.text: The originally planned complete StrategyDisplayCategoryTests pass is replaced by an exact new Follow Market test pass plus a before/after no-new-failures comparison for the complete class, because clean approved parent 4762d746 already fails six unrelated stale catalog-count assertions with the same actual values as the changed tree.
deviations.impact: This task will not update or suppress the six unrelated stale-count tests. Verification will prove the new Follow Market behavior directly and prove that the category change introduces no additional class failure; fixing the six pre-existing tests remains outside this Dashboard Follow Market request.
